items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I had a flare up with Benny in Columbus, Ohio... he changed his mind and called a rehearsal -- and I went to the date anyway.

ctx.x: Ben Pollack -- and that's the first time I heard Benny Goodman and there he is sitting there in short pants---(laughter)- like--
Was he really wearing short pants--
